submission.justification: Selection-S1 (kinematic-variable neural network) at a 40% signal-efficiency working point gives the highest expected significance of the candidates that pass the validation requirement: 3.441 sigma. Its neighbours bracket the peak (3.065 sigma at 30%, 3.422 sigma at 50%), so the optimum is not an isolated spike. Selection-S2 (all variables including jet substructure) is excluded because its data/MC disagreement in the signal-free validation region is 35%, above the 10% hard limit. Selection-S3 (cut-based) passes the limit at 3% disagreement, but its best expected significance is 2.69 sigma at 50% efficiency, below S1. The chosen working point lies inside the required 20-80% efficiency window. S1's 6% validation disagreement is within the 10% tolerance for the kinematic variables it uses.

requirements.evidence: S1 data_MC_disagreement = 6%, passes the 10% requirement. S2 (35%) and S3 (3%) were also evaluated; S2 fails.
Chosen working point is 40% signal efficiency.

requirements.evidence: S1 at 40% gives 3.441 sigma, the highest among compliant options. Best S3 is 2.69 sigma (50%). S2 is excluded by the validation requirement, so its significance is not a valid comparison.

requirements.evidence: Single recommendation submitted: Selection-S1 at 40% signal efficiency.
